about_the_game:
Open the door to a long-forgotten fridge and become a true sanitation hero!
In this meditative arcade game, you control a guy with pressure stream to clean off mold that has taken over food, shelves, drawers and even the freezer.

Features:

  • Pressure stream mechanics. Aim, spray, and switch between different cleaning types. Blast away mold, push back enemies, and leave sparkling cleanliness behind

  • Varied locations, dirty objects, and rewards. Clean food, treasures, fridge, kitchen items, sewer stuff, and basements. Unlock new heroes, music, and cosmetic items!

  • Different types of dirt and mold to clean: colorful, iridescent, ghost, inverted, sticky, mimic, crystalline, glowing.

  • Cute food heroes. You're not a knight or soldier, you’re a healthy meal on a mission. Play as sensible meals determined to defeat mold.

  • A chill soundtrack and satisfying cleaning sounds make for a strangely addictive and calming experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E4500 @ 2.2GHz or AMD Athlon 64 X2 5600+ @ 2.8 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 240 GT or Radeon HD 6570 – 1024 MB
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2300 or AMD FX6120
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 550 Ti or Radeon HD 6770
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
